dedupe_keys.name: public libraries in england basic and extended basic dataset 1 july 2016

description: This dataset lists the static public libraries in England, statutory and non-statutory, as at 1 July 2016, with the type of each library and its opening hours. It was published by the Department for Digital, Culture, Media and Sport on GOV.UK on 30 March 2017, with an extended basic dataset added in January 2018, as the basis of a wider core dataset for public libraries led by the Libraries Taskforce. Files are the basic dataset CSV, the extended basic dataset CSV and a PDF of the definitions used for library types, which may differ from other sources. Coverage: all 151 library services in England, which validated the data. Access: GOV.UK downloads. Licence: Open Government Licence v3.0; free. Caveats: a single 2016 snapshot, and the publisher notes occasional errors are possible. Simulation uses: mapping community buildings that can serve as warm spaces, cooling centres or information points in emergencies, and access analysis. Related records: the Scotland GP practices and NHS hospital records.
